steps.note: S0.1.3.1.1 states the net target change (JV+RG)x independent of the initial scratch vectors a,c, quoting the row-by-row argument (rows 6 and 7 restore c,a) at line 744 in its proper role.
S0.1.3.1.2 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, and self coefficient one.
S0.1.3.1.3 gives the complex-case central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 cancelled by the side wires for intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero.
S0.1.3.1.4 states the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) with the inverse schedule X<-X-Y, and S0.1.3.1 states every scratch wire is returned to its initial value.
The plan states that every edge joins comparable labels (S0.1.3.4.1) but never gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions (the residual table).

S0.1.3.3.5 gives only the inclusion P(x)<t_X> in P(x)t_Y^perp from t_X perp t_Y (line 953, label construction); the residual of edge 2->5, the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2, is never stated.
The plan states that center 3->4 is the only decreasing edge, losing h, that signed changes telescope with sources N and sinks Wm-N to Wm-2N, and that absolute changes add 2L to give Wm-2N+2L.

The plan uses orthonormal residual bases (S0.1.5.1.2, S0.1.5.2.1) but never argues that each nonzero binary residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating, or that alternating planes are absorbed to give an orthonormal basis.

S0.1.5.1.5 gives weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, and S0.1.5.1.6 (quote of line 1246) assigns each orthonormal residual vector its coefficient wt(v) in the phase. The sum formula q_V-q_U is not displayed, but the plan states its content this way.
S0.1.5.1.6 states that odd weight gives the phase i^{eps[v.x]}, written as (1+i^eps)/2+(1-i^eps)/2(-1)^{v.x}, which H diag(1,-1) H = X turns into aI+bX_v or its inverse.
S0.1.5.2.3 and S0.1.5.2.6 state that each residual basis vector yields one factor (C^{eps})^{tensor f} acting on all f columns of its slot, s_c such factors in all (also S0.1.5.1.3).

S0.1.5.1.7 gives the X_a->Y_a exception (C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), repaired by Z_{a,k} before and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} after, via C=iZC^{-1}Z), and S0.1.5.1.4 states undoing the signed bank exchange. The zero-label frame I and full-label frame C^{tensor m} are not stated explicitly.
The plan states that both loss ratios are below 1/2, that the deficit N-2L_b>0 from W_b m, and that s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m.
The plan states that both deficits exceed 20*2^{-50} and that log m<20 gives m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta), so s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}.
The plan gives the pivot at the rightmost entry of the topmost nonzero row, clearing by lower-triangular elementary operations, and repetition on the active indices leaving exactly a ones.
S0.1.4.1.3.1 states the fixed odd prime that avoids every denominator in the finite factor table and every diagonal numerator, so the identities specialise to Z/q^b Z.
S0.1.4.1.3.2 states that a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V), updating coordinates in descending physical order while earlier ones keep their original values.
S0.1.4.1.3.4 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, then D_j<-H_i-D_j, with one interchange per one of Pi, and S0.1.4.1.3.5 gives a in all.
S0.1.5.7.1 defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3}, C_0=128mB^2 and Delta, and S0.4.1.1 fixes C_1=20; nu=11 is not stated.
The plan bounds the per-invocation count by 24W^3+4s+4W+4<E and gives A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at an internal node and A(e)<=8e at a leaf.
The plan states sx+E<=Bx, B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, and the total below C_0 d^{C_1}.
The plan states that depth-ell values lie in 2^{-(p+ell)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^ell, that p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits suffice, and that eps*C_1<1 gives Delta=o(p).
S0.1.5.10 states that every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and truncation errs by less than sqrt2*2^{-p}.

summary: P05 quotes the paper's derivations densely, so 23 of 26 sub-steps are present. The gaps are all in label-residual-budget: the residual table (L1), the h-2 residual of the side edge 2->5 (L2), and the binary nonalternating/orthonormal-basis argument (L4). P1 and P4 count as present with small gaps: the sum formula for q_V-q_U is carried only through the per-vector phase coefficient, and the zero/full-label endpoint frames are not stated. No sub-step is stated contrary to the paper.
